purpose.zh: 练大腿和臀部力量，提升单腿稳定
purpose.en: Build leg and glute strength and single-leg stability.

text.zh: 后撤一步，双膝弯曲，后膝接近地面
text.en: Step back and bend both knees until the back knee nearly touches the floor

text.zh: 前膝在脚踝上方，上身直立微前倾
text.en: Keep the front knee over the ankle and your trunk tall with a slight lean.

text.zh: 前脚跟发力站起，收回后脚
text.en: Drive through the front heel to stand and bring the back foot in.

commonErrors.en: Letting the front knee cave in.

cautions.zh: 膝盖疼痛时减小下蹲深度，仍痛就停止
cautions.en: Lunge less deep if your knees hurt, and stop if the pain continues.
